crossRefs.note: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…

“Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
